question.text: For a listed NPO on SSE, the Annual Impact Report (AIR) has a DUAL role per Chapter 7.3.2. Identify the correct pair.

answer.text: Trend analysis and providing a baseline/midline for successive years

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 7.3.2 states: 'The Annual Impact reports typically perform a dual role, viz. (i) prepare a trend analysis of the NPO/FPEs performance and (ii) provide a baseline and midline for successive years.' **The Trap:** Options B, C, D are tax/corporate-governance functions, not AIR functions. **Cross-Exam Context:** Trend analysis + baseline is the same discipline expected in Management Discussion & Analysis (MD&A) in LODR annual reports (III-A/III-C). **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** In the AIR, structure indicators as three columns: Baseline (prior year), Current Year, Target (next year). SEs that present single-year snapshots rob the reader of trend interpretability — and the SIA should insist on this three-column format.
